tweets.content: RT by @cz_binance: Strictly speaking, bitcoin:native is disinflationary, not purely deflationary. New coins are still being created, so the total supply is still growing (albeit very slowly; the current annual inflation rate is only ~0.82%). True deflation requires the supply to shrink. binancecoin:native is genuinely deflationary, more strictly so than Bitcoin. No new coins are minted. Its supply was created at launch. There is zero ongoing issuance. On top of this, active burning permanently destroys tokens, so the total supply keeps shrinking over time. The 36th quarterly burn on July 15, 2026 destroyed 1,615,828 BNB BEP-95 real-time burn is less talked about. A fixed portion of every transaction’s gas fees is burned automatically in real time. This has already removed roughly 290,000+ since it started.
tweets.translated: RT @cz_binance：严格来说，bitcoin:native 是反通货膨胀的，而不是纯粹的通货紧缩。新的硬币仍在被创造，因此总供应量仍在增长（尽管非常缓慢；当前的年通货膨胀率仅为约0.82％）。真正的通货紧缩需要供给减少。 binancecoin:native 是真正的通货紧缩，比比特币更严格。没有铸造新硬币。它的供应是在发布时创建的。持续发行量为零。最重要的是，主动销毁会永久销毁代币，因此总供应量随着时间的推移不断减少。 2026年7月15日第36季度销毁销毁1,615,828 BNB BEP-95实时销毁较少被提及。每笔交易的固定部分的 Gas 费都会实时自动燃烧。自启动以来，该活动已删除了大约 290,000 多个内容。

tweets.content: I think we're seeing AI server MLCC demand cause an interesting effect... with tightening capacity for consumer/general-purpose MLCCs. If you get Vietnam flashbacks like I do to $MU / Samsung / SK Hynix -> Legacy DRAM: My thesis is we'll see the same thing here maybe late H2, early 2027 with consumer/broad MLCCs. From July 6th: "the crowding-out effect from AI-oriented high-end MLCC production has begun spilling over into both the automotive and consumer markets." July 28th: "AI Demand Pushes Japanese and Korean MLCC Suppliers to Record Monthly Shipments; Consumer-Grade Order Spillovers Continue to Surge" Aug 12: As [MLCC] capacity shifts from consumer grades to AI-oriented products... (Trendforce) Aug 12: China's electronics market channel checks found 22µF and 47µF MLCCs (used more broadly) out of stock. Then found and said certain manufacturers had stopped taking orders. (for reference: Walsin said high-volume smartphone/PC products such as... 22µF, so it's broader MLCCs) Obviously Samsung Electro-Mechanics/Murata are main beneficiaries of AI server MLCC ramp. But companies with large market share of overall MLCCs like Taiyo Yuden (6976, disclosure: I have positions) with less AI server share, would be a major beneficiary of this. Fun part is, we're only in H2 2026, so the next major bottleneck should be fun!
tweets.translated: 我认为我们看到人工智能服务器 MLCC 需求产生了有趣的影响……消费/通用 MLCC 的产能收紧。如果你像我对 $MU / 三星 / SK 海力士那样得到越南闪回 -> 传统 DRAM：我的论点是，我们可能会在 2027 年下半年末、2027 年初在消费者/广泛的 MLCC 上看到同样的事情。从7月6日起：“面向人工智能的高端MLCC生产的挤出效应已经开始蔓延到汽车和消费市场。” 7 月 28 日：“AI 需求推动日韩 MLCC 供应商月度出货量创历史新高；消费级订单溢出持续激增” 8 月 12 日：随着 [MLCC] 产能从消费级转向面向 AI 的产品……（Trendforce） 8 月 12 日：中国电子市场渠道检查发现 22μF 和 47μF MLCC（用途更广泛）缺货。然后发现说某些厂家已经停止接单了。 （供参考：Walsin 表示大批量智能手机/PC 产品，例如……22μF，因此它是更广泛的 MLCC）显然，三星电机/村田是 AI 服务器 MLCC 增长的主要受益者。但像太阳诱电（6976，披露：我有仓位）这样在整体 MLCC 市场份额较大但 AI 服务器份额较少的公司将成为主要受益者。有趣的是，我们才进入 2026 年下半年，所以下一个主要瓶颈应该很有趣！

tweets.content: "Severe InP Shortage Triggers Largest Price Hike Ever" - $AXTI. Suppliers have bluntly stated that "even if you have the money, you still may not be able to get the material" (lol). - Industry sources revealed that InP substrate prices began rising in Q4 last year and was the fourth consecutive substrate price hike. - The latest Q4 hike is expected to be >10%, - Meanwhile, prices for epitaxial wafers made from those substrates have already been raised two times, and the market is moving toward a 3rd consecutive increase in Q4. (I also wrote a thesis on $IQE, which benefits here too). Article states VPEC, Landmark, IET benefits (Taiwan centric reporting). I did predict this last year... The bottleneck is real, but I do have higher expectations for price hikes that comes next. Glad it's starting to play out.
tweets.translated: “严重的 InP 短缺引发有史以来最大的价格上涨”- $AXTI。供应商直言“即使有钱，也不一定能买到材料”（笑）。 - 业内人士透露，InP衬底价格从去年第四季度开始上涨，并且是连续第四次上涨。 - 最新第四季度涨幅预计>10%， - 与此同时，由这些基板制成的外延片价格已上涨两次，市场正朝着第四季度连续第三次上涨的方向发展。 （我还写了一篇关于 $IQE 的论文，这在这里也有好处）。文章阐述了 VPEC、Landmark、IET 优势（以台湾为中心的报告）。我去年确实预测过这一点……瓶颈确实存在，但我确实对接下来的价格上涨抱有更高的期望。很高兴它开始发挥作用。
